comment: The Bible texts of the cubit-bible asset package (APP-005), pinned by SHA-256. tools/build_bible.py fetches each once (https only, empty environment), refuses a mismatch, converts it and copies the licence statements below into BIBLE-NOTICE. The files are untrusted data: they are read as zip archives of USFM text and never executed. eBible.org regenerates its archives; a changed archive is refused, never used: re-pin it after checking the change (tools/build_bible.py --pin NAME).

translations.name: kjv
translations.title: King James Version (1769) with Apocrypha
translations.publisher: eBible.org and the CrossWire Bible Society (archive dated 2026-11-03)
translations.licence: Public Domain. The King James Version of 1611, Oxford standard text of 1769, with the Apocrypha. Outside the United Kingdom it is in the public domain; in the United Kingdom the rights are vested in the Crown under letters patent (the Queen's/King's Printer's patent), so printing it there or importing printed copies needs permission. eBible.org: "You may copy the King James Version of the Holy Bible freely."

translations.name: bsb
translations.title: Berean Standard Bible
translations.publisher: BSB Publishing, LLC, through eBible.org (archive dated 2026-10-30)
translations.licence: Public Domain. The Berean Standard Bible was dedicated to the public domain by BSB Publishing on 30 April 2023 (berean.bible/terms.htm): it may be freely copied, distributed, published and translated.

translations.name: web
translations.title: World English Bible with the Deuterocanon
translations.publisher: eBible.org (Michael Paul Johnson; 2020 stable text, archive dated 2026-10-30)
translations.licence: Public Domain. "The World English Bible is in the Public Domain. That means that it is not copyrighted. However, 'World English Bible' is a Trademark of eBible.org. ... All we ask is that if you CHANGE the actual text of the World English Bible in any way, you not call the result the World English Bible any more." CuBit does not change the text: footnotes, cross-references and Strong's numbers are left out, and the words are unchanged.

translations.name: vul
translations.title: Biblia Sacra Vulgata Clementina
translations.publisher: eBible.org (latVUC, "Bibbia Vulgata Clementina na 1598": the Clementine Vulgate, Sixto-Clementine text of 1598, with the Glossa Ordinaria of the Migne edition of 1880 in its footnotes; source files dated 2025-12-12, archive dated 2026-10-30)
translations.licence: Public Domain. The Clementine Vulgate, Saint Jerome's Latin Bible in the edition issued under Pope Clement VIII (1592; this text of 1598), is in the public domain. eBible.org (copr.htm): "Public Domain ... Translation by: Jerome". It is not the Stuttgart Biblia Sacra Vulgata, which is copyrighted. CuBit leaves out the footnotes (the Glossa Ordinaria) and keeps the words, including the edition's square brackets around quoted speech and psalms. Its appendix (3 and 4 Esdras, the Prayer of Manasseh) is not in this source.
